changed.title: Known result rebuilt. Exact routing length for invertible binary affine maps with cyclic feedback
changed.statement:
∀ (b L : ℕ),
  let w := b + 1
  let V := Fin w → ZMod 2
  (∀ (g : V ≃ₗ[ZMod 2] V) (v : V),
    ∃ (tap : Fin L → Fin b → ZMod 2) (bias : Fin L → ZMod 2),
      ∀ x : V, (List.finRange L).foldl (fun (s : V) i =>
        let tail := fun j : Fin b => s j.succ
        Fin.snoc (α := fun _ : Fin w => ZMod 2) tail
          (s 0 + bias i + ∑ j : Fin b, tap i j * tail j)) x = g x + v) ↔
    2 * w - 1 ≤ L
changed.unlocks: determines the exact physical length needed for a binary shift register to realize all invertible affine maps
changed.context: Build a suffix flag complementary to both the input and target coordinate prefix flags. At each extension avoid the union of two proper hyperplanes. Choose its basis adapted to the input prefix flag. The initial forward sweep writes this triangular basis, leaving the initial bit unchanged. A second sweep writes the targets since each mixed list is a basis. Absorb biases and omit the initial fixed rotation by retargeting. At 2w-2 steps the last two logical cells have one visit each. Swapping them would duplicate an untouched bit. For w=1 use the flip.

changed.title: The 5 by 5 bipartite graph with mask 11700309 is represented on the one-a-side promise by an AND/OR/NOT circuit of fan-in two with at most 10 gates
changed.statement: ∃ C : PEqualNP.CircuitLowerBounds.Circuit, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.FanInTwo C ∧ C.size ≤ 10 ∧ PEqualNP.Represents.Represents (fun u v : Fin 5 => (11700309 : ℕ).testBit (5 * u.val + v.val)) C
changed.unlocks: Whether a NOT gate pays under a checked AND/OR floor of 11 on this side-5 graph, by leaving its classes of equal rows or columns unread.
changed.sketch: We hold no circuit of 10 gates; this is a search. This graph has a class of 2 equal rows, which a circuit with NOT gates may leave unread. Give a gate list of AND, OR and NOT gates of fan-in two, at most 10 gates, judged by evaluation on the 25 promise inputs. The graph needs at least 11 AND/OR gates by a checked floor row (search 'mask 11700309'). An exhausted search is a report, not a proof.

changed.title: The Boolean degree of each second-channel image bounds the number of common words per third-channel tag
changed.statement:
∀ (k r c : ℕ),
  let F := ZMod 2
  let X := Fin k → F
  let Z := Fin r → F
  let W := X × Z
  ∀ (send : W → X) (tag : W → Fin c → Bool),
    (∀ a b t : W, a.1 = b.1 → send b = send t → tag t = tag a → a = b ∧ b = t) →
    let volume := fun d : ℕ => ∑ j ∈ Finset.range (min k d + 1), k.choose j
    (∀ d : ℕ,
      (∀ u : X, ∃ coeff : Finset (Fin k) → F, ∀ y : X,
        (∑ S ∈ Finset.univ.filter (fun S : Finset (Fin k) => S.card ≤ d),
          coeff S * ∏ j ∈ S, y j) =
        (if y ∈ Finset.univ.image (fun z : Z => send (u,z)) then (1 : F) else 0)) →
      (∀ h : Fin c → Bool, (Finset.univ.filter (fun w : W => tag w = h)).card ≤ volume d) ∧
      2^(k+r) ≤ 2^c * volume d) ∧
    ((∀ u : X, ∃ (A : Z →ₗ[F] X) (v : X), ∀ z : Z, send (u,z) = A z + v) →
      r ≤ k ∧ 2^(k+r) ≤ 2^c * volume (k-r))
changed.unlocks: bounds the number of words per tag before optimizing the conditional affine witness
changed.context: Fix a third tag. Two distinct words with this tag cannot share a short endpoint or have a cross pair in the image, since that pair supplies a middle word. The row-image indicators, evaluated at the selected second strings, give an identity matrix. Degree-d indicators lie in the span of the square-free monomials of size at most d, bounding each tag class by that dimension. Sum over tags. Affine suffix maps are injective in each row. Their images have codimension k-r and membership is a product of k-r affine tests.

changed.title: A joint encoding of many translated-list choices still forces high degree for every nonzero parity of fixed answers
changed.statement:
∀ (g a : Nat), 0 < g → 0 < a →
  let M := 2^a
  let m := M-1
  let d := g*a
  let V := Fin g × Fin m × Fin a
  let W := V → Bool
  let deg := fun (b : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ b) ∧
      ∀ input, f input = (((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ j ∈ mon, input j = true)).card % 2) == 1)
  let Y := Fin g → Fin M
  let valid := fun (x : W) (choice : Y) =>
    ∀ j i, ∃ v : Fin a, x (j,i,v) ≠ (choice j).val.testBit v.val
  let run := fun (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (x : W) =>
    (List.range d).foldl (fun h pos => h + ((ask pos h x).toNat <<< pos)) 0
  (∃ (choose : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (decode : Nat → Y),
    (∀ (u : Fin d) (h : Nat),
      deg ((u.val%a+1)*2^(a-1-u.val%a)) (choose u.val h)) ∧
    ∀ input, valid input (decode (run choose input))) ∧
  (∀ (n : Nat) (choose : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (decode : Nat → Y),
    (∀ input, valid input (decode ((List.range n).foldl (fun trace tick =>
      trace + ((choose tick trace input).toNat <<< tick)) 0))) → d ≤ n) ∧
  ∀ (ask : Fin d → W → Bool) (report : (Fin d → Bool) → Y)
    (label : Fin g → Fin m → Fin M → Fin a → Bool),
    (∀ x j i, (fun rawBit => x (j,i,rawBit)) ≠ label j i (report (fun u => ask u x) j)) →
    ∀ (mask : Finset (Fin d)), mask.Nonempty → ∀ b : Nat,
      deg b (fun word => (((mask.filter (fun bitId => ask bitId word = true)).card % 2) == 1)) →
      2^(a-1) ≤ b
changed.unlocks: Separates the total degree of a minimum-length fixed batch from the adaptive selector on many groups.
changed.context: Concatenate the absent-prefix selectors. Every tuple of labels can be forced by independent inputs in the groups, so shorter transcripts cannot suffice. At exact length ga the report on all transcripts is bijective. A nonempty parity becomes a nonconstant test on the tuple of labels. Connect opposite-valued tuples by changing one label at a time. Some line has both values. The cut restriction on that line has at least 2^(a-1) independent OR variables.

changed.title: The exact residual covering cost of bounded total query degree followed by unrestricted binary questions
changed.statement:
∀ (m r D s L : Nat), 0 < r →
  let V := Fin m × Fin r
  let W := V → Bool
  let Symbol := Fin r → Bool
  let deg := fun (b : Nat) (f : W → Bool) =>
    ∃ terms : Finset (Finset V), (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card ≤ b) ∧ ∀ word,
      f word = (((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ v ∈ mon, word v = true)).card % 2) == 1)
  let low := fun (q : Symbol → Bool) => ∃ terms : Finset (Finset (Fin r)),
    (∀ mon ∈ terms, mon.card < r) ∧ ∀ word,
      q word = (((terms.filter (fun mon => ∀ z ∈ mon, word z = true)).card % 2) == 1)
  let run := fun (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (len : Nat) (x : W) =>
    (List.range len).foldl (fun h step => h + ((ask step h x).toNat <<< step)) 0
  let residual := m-D
  let covers := ∃ bad : Fin (2^s*L) → Fin residual → Symbol,
    ∀ x : Fin residual → Symbol, ∃ a, ∀ i, x i ≠ bad a i
  let possible := ∃ (n : Nat) (ask : Nat → Nat → W → Bool) (cost : Nat → Nat → Nat)
      (leaf : Nat → Fin L → Fin m → Symbol → Bool),
    (∀ h a i, low (leaf h a i)) ∧
    (∀ input (u : Fin n), deg (cost u.val (run ask u.val input))
      (ask u.val (run ask u.val input))) ∧
    (∀ word : W, (∑ t : Fin n, cost t.val (run ask t.val word)) ≤ D) ∧
    ∀ w : W, ∃ a, ∀ i, leaf (run ask (n+s) w) a i (fun v => w (i,v)) =
      decide (∀ v : Fin r, w (i,v) = true)
  possible ↔ covers
changed.unlocks: Gives an exact tradeoff among path degree, free answer bits and local predictor list size at all block counts.
changed.context: Each local predictor misses some symbol by its degree. Fix a reached prefix at the budget cut. Its maximal monomial touches at most D blocks. Zero errors force the reachable forbidden-word lists to cover the rest. Project to m-D blocks and pad to 2^s L slots. Conversely read one bit in each of min(D,m) blocks. On the others use product XOR the indicator of the forbidden symbol, whose top coefficient cancels. Split the cover into 2^s groups of L and encode a successful group with the unrestricted answers.
changed.sketch: Each local predictor misses some symbol by its degree. Fix a reached prefix at the budget cut. Its maximal monomial touches at most D blocks. Zero errors force the reachable forbidden-word lists to cover the rest. Project to m-D blocks and pad to 2^s L slots. Conversely read one bit in each of min(D,m) blocks. On the others use product XOR the indicator of the forbidden symbol, whose top coefficient cancels. Split the cover into 2^s groups of L and encode a successful group with the unrestricted answers.

changed.title: It is false that: Cubic piece, cycles at least 7, edge function plus OR-variables: a vertex whose deletion lowers fan-in-two AND/OR/NOT size by at least 4
changed.statement: ¬ (∀ (n : ℕ) (G : SimpleGraph (Fin n)) (A : Finset (Fin n)), (∀ v : Fin n, v ∉ A → (G.neighborSet v).ncard = 3) → (∀ (w : Fin n) (c : G.Walk w w), c.IsCycle → 7 ≤ c.length) → (∀ i j : Fin n, G.Adj i j → i ∉ A) → (∃ i1 j1 : Fin n, G.Adj i1 j1) → ∃ z : Fin n, z ∉ A ∧ ∀ s : ℕ, PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x : Fin n → Bool => @decide ((∃ a ∈ A, x a = true) ∨ ∃ i2 j2 : Fin n, G.Adj i2 j2 ∧ x i2 = true ∧ x j2 = true) (Classical.propDecidable _)) s → ∃ t : ℕ, t + 4 ≤ s ∧ PEqualNP.MetaComplexity.HasCircuitSize n (fun x' : Fin n → Bool => @decide ((∃ a' ∈ A, x' a' = true) ∨ ∃ i3 j3 : Fin n, (G.deleteEdges (G.incidenceSet z)).Adj i3 j3 ∧ x' i3 = true ∧ x' j3 = true) (Classical.propDecidable _)) t)
changed.unlocks: Proving it shows that a listed statement is false.
changed.context: The literal negation of another statement of the fleet; a counterexample to that statement proves it.
changed.sketch: A proof is one explicit counterexample to the positive statement L-meta-1593; none is expected if that statement is true.
